description: Raw budget-pacing configuration for a marketplace on a given date: the budget_pacing_json blob of cumulative spend-% targets by time-of-day, one row per date. The Python layer parses the JSON and derives per-bucket spend %, bucket start/end times, and bucket count. Single-date lookup (set start_date = end_date to the target date).

date.description: The date the budget-pacing configuration applies to. Scope with start_date = end_date to fetch a single day's config.

budget_pacing_json.description: Raw budget-pacing JSON blob: cumulative spend-% targets keyed by time-of-day. Passed through verbatim; the Python layer json.loads it and derives per-bucket pct, start/end times, and bucket count.

placeholder_metric.description: Constant 0. Row-level passthrough report with no aggregated metric; KAM requires at least one metric to fetch.

query.REPORTING: SELECT __ATTRIBUTES__, __METRICS__ FROM reporting.os_ads_marketplace_budget_pacing_configurations AS bpc JOIN reporting.clients AS mc ON SAFE_CAST(bpc.marketplace_client_id AS STRING) = mc.client_id WHERE mc.agency_id = '__AGENCY_ID__' AND bpc.date BETWEEN '__START_DATE_1__' AND '__END_DATE_1__' AND __FILTER__;
